about.title: Stucco Manufacturing Factory — Elit Dekor
about.p1: Elit Dekor is a trusted company based in Samarkand, producing and installing gypsum products since 2018. We create decorative and architectural gypsum elements — cornices, rosettes, columns and custom orders using modern technologies.
about.p2: Every product undergoes strict quality control. Our projects are widely represented in Samarkand and neighboring regions. We supply only long-lasting gypsum products made from natural raw materials.
about.p3: We provide a full range of services from the design stage to finished installation.

faq.subtitle: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.title: Still have questions?
faq.desc: Find answers to the most common questions here.
faq.q1: How far in advance should I place an order?
faq.a1: Small orders are usually ready in 3–5 business days. For large or custom projects, we recommend reaching out 2–3 weeks in advance.
faq.q2: Do you deliver outside of Tashkent?
faq.a2: Yes, we deliver across Uzbekistan. Contact us to find out delivery costs and timelines.
faq.q3: Do you provide a product warranty?
faq.a3: Yes. All our products are made from 100% natural gypsum and come with a quality guarantee. If a defect is found, we will replace or fix it.
faq.a4: Yes, our experienced craftsmen provide professional installation. The price depends on the volume and complexity of the project.
faq.q5: Is there a minimum order quantity?
faq.a5: Minimum order quantities vary by product type. Some items have no minimum, while others follow the conditions in our price list.

AboutPage.title: Elit Dekor — Gypsum Stucco Factory
AboutPage.desc1: Elit Dekor is a reliable company engaged in the production and installation of gypsum products in Samarkand since 2018.
AboutPage.desc2: In our catalog there are more than 5000 types of products made of gypsum, glass fiber gypsum and glass fiber concrete, and they are constantly replenished. Our offices and showrooms are located in Samarkand, with a network of representatives.
AboutPage.desc3: We are always ready to manufacture custom gypsum stucco according to your sketches and perform professional installation.
AboutPage.adv1_desc: All products are manufactured in our own factory following all standards
AboutPage.adv2_desc: Over 5000 product types for any interior and facade style
AboutPage.adv3_desc: Design, production, delivery, and installation under one roof
AboutPage.adv4_desc: Over 20 years in stucco market. Thousands of completed projects

FasadPage.title: Glass Fiber Reinforced Concrete (GFRC)
FasadPage.desc1: Glass Fiber Reinforced Concrete (GFRC) is a composite material made of cement matrix reinforced with glass fibers. It has high strength, frost resistance, and durability.
FasadPage.desc2: Ideal for facade decoration: cornices, columns, pilasters, and other architectural elements.

FibrogipsPage.title: Glass Fiber Gypsum (GFG)
FibrogipsPage.desc1: Glass Fiber Gypsum (GFG) is a composite material made of gypsum and glass fiber. It offers high strength, lightness, and capability to form complex architectural shapes.
FibrogipsPage.desc2: GFG products are ideal for interior decoration with high ceilings, domes, arches, and facade works.
FibrogipsPage.use2_desc: Cornices, rosettes, moldings made of GFG
FibrogipsPage.use3_desc: Cornices, columns, pilasters made of GFG
